name: The Florida Aquarium
tagline: Starter list: African penguins, then a two-toed sloth and moon jellies — river otters, not sea otters.

practical.best_start: Shark / open ocean wow, then touch if open.

bonus_hunt.tagline: Florida bonus · penguins + sloth + Moon Bay

challenges.text: African penguin: watch one bird enter or leave the water.
Moon Bay: watch one pulse from top to bottom.
Loggerhead: flippers busy or a still float?
